answer_2.quote: We report accuracy as the primary metric, where lower accuracy indicates a higher degree of hallucinations.

answer_3.quote: For open-ended questions, we adopt a two-step approach: first, we determine whether the model implicitly assumes the presence of an object using an LLM-as-judge framework with GPT-4o (to reduce model bias, we also use Gemini-Pro for LLM-as-judge); second, we independently assess the factual correctness of the response.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three English-proficient individuals to evaluate our benchmark, where each individual had strong foundational knowledge of computer vision. To reduce potential evaluator bias, we randomized the order of the question-answer pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were instructed to assess the correctness of model responses; inter-annotator reliability was measured using the Pearson correlation coefficient.
